title: AuditRecord
description: Immutable audit trail record written to BigQuery after adjuster sign-off. Captures full provenance: model/prompt versions, anchor IDs, protocol commit, system decision, and human decision.

audit_id.description: Unique audit record identifier, e.g. AUD-2026-001.

claim_id.description: Claim this audit record belongs to.

timestamp_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this audit record was created.

model_version.description: Pinned Gemini model version used for grading, e.g. 'gemini-2.0-flash-001'.

prompt_version.description: Semantic version of the grading prompt, e.g. 'v2.1.0'.

anchor_image_ids.description: IDs of the three visual reference anchors used (healthy, moderate, severe).

frozen_protocol_commit_hash.description: Git commit hash of the frozen trigger protocol file.

evidence_timestamp_utc.description: UTC timestamp when evidence (rainfall, NDVI) was retrieved.

cache_hit.description: True if the Gemini grading response was served from cache.

system_outcome_class.description: The concordance outcome the system computed.

adjuster_id.description: Identifier of the human adjuster, or null if not yet reviewed.

adjuster_notes.description: Free-text notes from the adjuster, or null.

decided_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the adjuster made their decision, or null if pending.
